about: W3 story voices, written by tools/voices/story-lines.mjs from the mission data (do not edit the missions part by hand). Every `say` line (with its `who`) of every campaign and Chronicle mission, and the lines of the staged scenes a mission plays, grouped in packs of at most ~300 KB. tools/voices/make-voices.py renders them with the cast's stock Kokoro voice and processing; the client finds a clip by storyHash(text) of the exact English line. `spoken` maps an on-screen line to a variant used only for the voice (the screen keeps its text).

excluded.briefing: Briefing lines are read on the briefing card before Begin mission; voicing them would fetch a pack before the match starts (the lazy-load rule: nothing before Start). On-screen only.
excluded.debrief: Debrief lines are read on the result card after the match; not part of this pass. On-screen only.

lines.text: Harvesters know their work, Commander. Let them cut alloy.
Pick a Harvester. Build a Supply relay near camp.
Supply relay online. Take your squad to the river.
It is waking! Four hundred years dark, and it works!
Meridian camp. Your relay killed my lights. Shut it down.
Ashfall at the ford. Vanguards in front, Rangers behind.
They pushed us off. Retake the circle.
I asked politely, Commander. I will not ask twice.
It is answering us, after four hundred years of sleep!
Every Ashfall light died the moment our relay woke.
Steady. But why does our light put out theirs?
A scout on the road! Vanguards can chase it off.
They attack in minutes. Harvesters first, the Foundry next.
Acid spitters nest on the south bank. Leave them be.
Acid Hounds eat metal! Breakers back, Rangers at range.
Den clear! Builder crates inside, worth one hundred and fifty alloy.
The Foundry is hot! Their relay dimmed the moment we lit.
Ashfall is moving. Meet them at the ford.
First Breaker rolling! Aim it at crowds.
Their guns cover the far side. Cross together, fast.
You cross my river and leave camp empty. Careless.
The bridgehead is down! The west bridge reaches their back fence.
East bridge charges, now. Nobody follows my crews.
He blew his own bridge! His raids must wade now.
Good. The ford is under our towers.
Ashfall holds the middle relay. It feeds their Foundry.
Twelve minutes. Every minute they stand, they build.
Keep the river. I have other camps.
Two scouts test our bank. Let the towers work.
Tower pads line the roads. Crew those by the crossings.
Seven quiet stretches will tune it. Hold every crossing!
That river is not yours. My columns cross hourly.
Two stretches done! The water slows them. Hit them at the ford.
Scrappers come in crowds. Breakers hit them all.
My sixth column crosses now, and it brings Scorchers. Stand aside.
One more stretch! It is almost in tune!
Battle tanks last. Anti-tank crews to the bridges.
Their gun is down! Build a tower there for cover.
The tower is up! Now hold the relay one minute.
The relay is on the island. The near ford leads there.
Their tower sees the whole ford. Cross and climb together.
That relay is mine, Meridian. Get off my island.
Ashfall is crossing the water. Keep guns on the island.
The island is ours! The valley hums as one.
No river here. Use the walls north of camp.
On schedule. Hold the walls, then chase them home.
Four towers up! The camp can guard itself now.
That siphon could run ten camps! Where does it go?
This beam points up. He is feeding something in orbit!
Forty thousand sleepers ride above us. Leave my siphons.
Received. Forty thousand will sleep warmer tonight. Noted.
Three hundred alloy, loaded. Hale will miss that.
Half his siphons are down. Expect everything now.
Eleven minutes. Scorchers come next. Finish the siphons.
That is no Ashfall design! It is a Builder war machine!
The Iron Vanguard. Nine weeks to dig out.
It marks the ground before firing. Avoid the red.
Its armour is cracking! It fires sooner now.
A third of its plating left. A pity.
It is down! Poor old thing.
Nine weeks of repairs, gone in minutes. Noted.
You made a cold night colder for innocent people.
Harvesters first. Then claim the west wreck.
The wreck is paying! Loose crystal, still warm.
That crystal was cut by my crews. Return it.
Second salvage crew, heading for our Harvesters.
This crystal is grey. The siphon drank it dry.
Then drained ground grows nothing. Remember that.
Enough! My riders yield, Commander. Name your terms.
Then we are even. I will not forget it.
So be it. My wells will remember.
The centre oasis is closest. Take it first.
Nothing personal, Commander. My gardens need that light too.
The north oasis feeds my last siphon. Remove them.
East oasis is ours! And the Sunward wells dropped.
Our camp is under attack. Guard home and both oases.
Captain Sol. Meridian drains us both. A truce?
I do not like you, Director. But agreed, for today.
Both columns are turning toward the centre oasis. Together.
Four minutes of daylight. Hold two oases one minute.
A Wyrm nest! The Caravan rides around those.
A Dune Wyrm is following us! It hunts tanks!
Tuned! Both oases steady. Why do the others go dim?
A scout on the dunes, watching our camp.
Four crawlers, one road, raiders on every bend.
Two crawlers entering the canyon. Two more soon.
The last two crawlers are in. Bring them home!
The crawlers cannot fight. Keep them behind the squad.
Meridian in my canyon. Outpost guard, down the road.
Raiders from the north. Hold the middle bend.
A Breaker shells the road from the north bend.
All raiders to the north mouth. Nothing leaves.
A crawler is badly hit! Medics to the crawlers!
The outpost is burning. No more raiders from there.
The crawlers are through! I can finish the core now.
The crawlers brought three Vanguards, a Breaker and a Medic.
I am driving this crawler. Keep the guns off me!
Both Pact armies are coming. Keep the crawler home.
Two Pact towers cover the far bank. Break them.
The ford is clear! Crawler moving. Slowly. One speed.
Crawler hull at half! A Medic, please!
This road is Caravan ground. I must stop you.
Then we take it by force, with two hundred alloy.
A fair offer. Two riders stay. The rest go home.
Relay site ahead. Clear the Sunward guards first.
Supply truck from the landing! Three Rangers, one Medic.
Core is in. Oh! The relays are one circuit!
Meridian, hear me. Your relays starve our children's wells.
One circuit? Then my wells were not your doing. Hale said otherwise.
A Pact scout in the trees. Show it our guns.
Economy first. More Harvesters, a second seam, guards for both.
Ashfall wants the Harvesters. Pull them behind your towers.
The seam is ours! These copper shards are new growth.
First charge is in! Look, the crystals are growing!
The relays do not burn crystal. They grow it!
If that relay wakes, my siphons fail. Hit their Harvesters.
Ashfall has the seam. Take it back, Commander.
Violet coats on the north-west rim! Not Ashfall.
Veil Survey scouts. Leave them be.
Movement on the west pass. Watch that flank!
West pass, now. Their yard stands open.
Only scouts. They saw our towers and ran.
Ten minutes gone. Raiders are heading for our seam.
Storm in four minutes. Harvesters to the nearest deposit.
We made the quota, and the Basin relay is awake!
Two Ashfall scouts on the basin road. See them off.
Rangers to the refinery. Whatever comes wants the copper.
Lights over the east rim again! Coming this way!
Your refinery starves my fleet. My balloons will close it.
A fire balloon, drifting at the refinery!
Towers cannot reach Ember balloons. Rangers can.
Research Anti-air guns at the Command core. Towers will shoot up.
We copied a gunship from Ashfall! Level 3 cores build Hawks.
Kites in front! They count your guns.
The refinery is burning! Shoot the balloons first!
You kept our alloy. Tonight I collect it.
You returned our alloy. I aim only at the refinery.
Three raids beaten. Their balloon yard is on the east rim.
My yard is burning. Noted. Two weeks of work, gone.
No more balloons! And look, Sunward silk!
Send a Ranger up the ramp, then build on top.
My column takes the ridge road. Your hill will not help.
The last column is the biggest! Keep firing!
The ridge is ours. High ground wins the early fights.
Three Hawks, rebuilt from Hale's balloon wrecks!
Anti-tank crews guard the moorings. Ground troops first.
Anti-tank crews! Keep the Hawks back a moment.
Gunships over my moorings. Crews, aim up.
An Ember balloon is up. Hawks, take it.
A Hawk is smoking! Pull it back!
All three moorings down. The sky is ours today.
A troop truck! Shoot it before it unloads.
I am coming myself, Commander.
My machines are spent, Commander. I yield the field.
A debt, then. I will repay it.
Then I will not be taking orders from you.
Three minutes to the first wave. Build towers east.
Both armies at once. Hold at the towers.
They say your relay dries my wells. Is it true?
Breakers on the ridge! Sally out, or lose the towers.
Every relay shares one line! Vale, send this map out!
All camps, nobody stole your power. Read the map.
I have seen it. I need power, not truth.
I have seen it. For our alloy, fewer guns tonight.
The relay is cracking! Engineers, please, quickly!
If that map is true, I fought the wrong camp.
Then stand aside, Captain. My last wave needs nobody.
One minute. Everything you have, around the relay.
Tuning complete! The relay held. You held, Commander.
Two scouts from the Pact are testing our towers.
Crew the lower pads first. They climb from below.
Meridian. That plateau is not on your schedule.
First reading! The lines bend toward the ash plains.
Second reading! Something is buried under the Ashfall camp.
Scrappers on the road. Breaker crews where it bends.
A Kite over the gorge. Rangers and Anti-tank crews, fire!
Third reading. A Builder vault, with a key inside!
I have counted your towers. One tank for each.
Last column, everything Hale has left. Hold the top.
Balloons behind the column! Keep Rangers near the top.
Squad is down. The nearest jammer is north. Quietly.
Four guards, not looking. Breaker first, then Rangers.
That Sentinel tower outranges your Breaker. Rush it.
I am hit! Not badly. Fairly badly. A Medic?
All three jammers are down! To the door!
Door open. This one is ECHO. First visitors in 412 years.
The Builders did not fall. They left.
A grey coat took the Keystone key. He wants all the power.
The camp is awake. Get Okoro out.
Their depot is burning. Hale marches a day late.
A Builder guardian! It tests everyone who comes.
It only moves when struck. Attack to take the test.
It is standing! Do not destroy it. Show strength.
Stop shooting! It is kneeling. I think we passed.
The guardian walks with us. Keep it by Okoro.
We made it out, and ECHO came too!
West and south relays are close. Light them.
One relay lit. This one is counting the circuit.
I see your light, Commander. So do my crews.
Every light draws them. Guard the circles.
Two lights. The count is climbing.
Raiders by the glow. Both circles, hold!
Three lights! Forty relays answer. This one sees far.
Counted. Every line runs to the Keystone.
My beacon is the gold light. Hurry!
Captain Sol. You broke the pact. I regret this.
You came. I did not listen. The Caravan pays its debts.
For the forest light, we pay you back twice.
You let me go. Take two hundred alloy, and my Riders.
Take the dune plateau. Hale's columns must climb to you.
The beacon is breaking! It is our road home!
The shelling has stopped. The children are safe.
Ashfall is hitting our camp too. Stay together.
We hold the top. Keep back from the edge.
You have met ECHO. Now meet the Wardens.
The first patterns. Every unit copies them. This one is sorry.
Machines on your road! My second column is yours.
The dunes are quiet at last. What comes next?
Their camp is down too. Hale needs fuel elsewhere.
The nest of the old one. Five young ones guard it.
The Elder Wyrm rides with you! Nobody tamed it before!
My well crew is stuck on the south road!
Reach them in seventy-five seconds, before the drones.
Riders are fastest. Send two, Commander.
My crew is safe! Two Riders ride with you.
They walked home alone. Slow, but safe.
Two scouts from Ashfall on the sand. See them off.
Three wagons, one road. Clear it ahead of us.
Wardens, hold the road. No water passes.
A Warden patrol from the north. Guard the wagons.
The cistern is full. Now the east wells!
A wagon is leaking! Medics, please!
I can see the well towers. Almost home.
Water in the wells. The gardens drink tonight.
The crystal here is greener already. This one notes it.
Six soldiers coming by truck to the muster point!
The storm has turned. The Veil yields, Commander.
You are kinder than I was told. Thank you.
Then the Veil will not forget this.
West and south dampers are close. The centre is far.
Three armies, three directions. Towers on every side.
Our first camp stood here. A storm took it overnight.
Archivist, that relay woke alone. In tune, no storms come.
A machine would say so. I buried forty friends here.
Thank you. My crews are walking out.
Then I cannot stop you. May the sky stay clear.
Riders on the south road! Late, dusty and ready!
The Crown is free. Hold the circle one minute.
All commands to the plateau centre. Stop them.
Tuning. Sixty relays answer. Sixty-one. Hold the circle.
Fifteen minutes. Heavy machines now. Anti-tank to the front.
Commander, three armies. Turn back, and nobody falls.
He is buying time. Keep on the dampers.
Sixty-four relays in tune. Look up, Archivist.
The Crown is lit, with no storm. Never before.
Two Warden sentries at the storm line. Towers will answer.
Scout the ramps. Breakers below can hit the towers.
Intruders below the crown. Sending a patrol.
The crown is lost. Retaking it.
Build a tower on the crown, now, before they climb!
Rangers and Anti-tank soldiers reach it in the air. Train plenty.
Our beacons keep it off our camp, not yours. I am sorry.
The Crown runs hot. Something big is flying home to it.
It is on the Crown. Bring the army up the road.
That is the fire that burned my camp. It remembers.
A Builder fire drake! Rangers and rockets reach it.
Step off the glow. When it lands, hit it hard.
It landed on the Crown! Everything on it now!
Its plates crack! Now it sweeps the fire wide.
Same rule. Off the glow, and keep firing.
It tires, but it breathes faster. Hold on.
It is down. A Builder guardian. Sorry, old one.
Thirty years I kept the highlands dark for that. Thank you.
A troop truck! Shoot it before it unloads.
The clock is running. Build as you march.
Wardens and Ashfall on our camp. Towers will hold.
Cross the ford together. Thin lines get cut.
One conduit cut. The draw slows by a third.
Wardens, to the west conduit. Guard it with everything.
The west conduit is scrap! The crystals stopped fading.
You cost me a day. I have forty thousand reasons.
Ten minutes. Sol sends her reserve. Last conduit.
Four minutes. The oldest crystals are turning to dust.
Fog off the rivers! Keep the army close.
The fog is lifting. Push on.
The north conduit is dark. The Lattice is whole.
Three conduits cut. I lost a day. The engine did not.
Two Ashfall scouts between the rivers. Hale counts us.
Pads on all three roads. Crew the basin first.
Hold ten waves, and the south is tuned for good!
Meridian. These roads are mine until my fleet is fed.
Two waves down. Keep the roads shut!
Two Gunner teams. Place them where Scrappers bunch up.
Warden Rangers on the north road. Gunners pin, crews finish.
Halfway! One Gunner pins a whole column in place.
Walkers from the Warden yards come first. Bought, not borrowed.
Walkers outrange tanks. Use Anti-tank crews and flank them.
Eight in tune. The Lattice is listening. Two more.
Last wave, everything Hale has left. Hold the basin.
Two towers and a squad hold the line. Build up.
Ashfall crews wait at three old relays. Something comes north.
My Kite watches the north road. We see first.
The relays woke with it. The south one is easiest.
There it is! Hale gave the Sovereign walking legs!
My Sovereign walks to your camp. My relays shield it.
That relay is failing. The last one takes the shield.
Last relay down! Shield gone! Everything on the Sovereign!
Then it walks without a shield. It has survived worse.
It stopped! The core runs hot. New guns too!
Same rule. Step off the red ground and keep shooting.
Half a Sovereign is still a Sovereign, Commander.
It is down for good. Sorry, old machine.
My last walker. Very well. The Keystone will decide.
Six soldiers coming by truck to the muster point!
You spared my crews. Ashfall sends three hundred alloy.
You saved my crews. The Veil sends two hundred energy.
Three armies in four minutes. Towers and Rangers first.
Here they come, from three sides! Caravan, stand with Meridian!
The first offensive is broken. North, to the engine.
My heavy wagons are here. Spend them well, Commander.
A week of readings. Hale's engine empties the Lattice.
Teo Lind here, captain of the Veil Shades. Half my crews left his line.
Then let them watch. Every idle Shade is one gun fewer.
You spared the Archivist. Two Stalkers are yours.
You would do the same for forty thousand of yours.
Director, a tuned Keystone feeds your fleet forever.
A year I can count. A promise, I cannot. Attack.
The Crown lit without a storm. The Veil stands down.
You freed my crews. Now I leave this war.
Thank you, Archivist. Your old camp records are open.
Ten minutes of Lattice left. Far relays go quiet.
Four minutes. Forget the camps. Everything on the engine!
Every camp broken! I am glad we are friends.
The engine is silent. One hundred and eight relays answer.
Meridian towers on every Keystone road. Ours to guard.
The engine is silent. Tuning the Keystone for all.
Four camps, one circuit. The dunes are glowing!
I can see every camp from here. All lit.
Two Scrapper scouts first. Let the towers take them.
Build a Salvage yard, Foreman. Wrecks pay better than rock.
Yard standing. Every machine falling near it is alloy.
Riders on the plain, after the Harvesters. Towers, please.
Those wrecks lay here four hundred years. Nobody owns them!
Captain Sol. My sleepers own them. Foreman, carry on.
Ten minutes. The fleet reports at the hour.
Keep your wrecks, Director. The dunes remember.
Their camp and towers are young, Foreman. Strike now.
Hold our bank, then cross while they count losses.
Director, we took nothing. We only woke a relay.
Then you will not miss it. Foreman, proceed.
Both towers down. Into the circle, Foreman. One minute.
They retook the circle. Clear it, Foreman.
Twelve minutes. Their Foundry will print Breakers soon.
They are shutting our relay down! Strange.
The relay is dark. Fleet power is up.
First column in thirty seconds. Crew the lowest pads.
Director, we only want the vault records. Let us pass.
You want the Keystone. So do I, for forty thousand.
Heavy machines come next. Put Anti-tank posts on the upper bends.
The gorge held. The cores are safe another month.
The bridge camp is nearest. Cross the south bridge.
Riders on our road. Towers, please, Foreman.
A Scrapper truck from the yard. Get it through.
Every wagon on this road pays the Caravan. Yours too.
I pay what I owe, Captain. Not tolls on cores.
Both camps down. The Captain waits at the forest.
Enough! The road is open. The Caravan has paid.
Let her ride home. Ashfall keeps its debts too.
Eleven minutes. The cores wait at the river.
The road is ours. A courtesy beats a funeral.
The centre oasis is nearest and lightly guarded.
Scrappers are heading for our wells. Guard the camp.
That is a Waystation! Shields mend three times faster here.
These pumps keep forty thousand people alive. Leave them.
My wells keep four thousand alive, Director.
Eleven minutes, and the water is still dropping. Faster!
All three pumps are sand. The wells are filling.
Take the centre oasis first. Then the weaker guard.
Captain Sol, we came for relays, not water.
You lit an oasis and my wells dropped.
The north oasis feeds my last siphon. I want it.
Raiders on our camp! Half home, half on the oases.
Captain Sol. Meridian drains us both. A truce?
I do not like you, Director. But agreed, for today.
Five minutes of light. Hold two oases one minute!
Both oases are ours. And Hale owes me a truce.
Take the south bridge. The road camp falls first.
Meridian is coming. They fight cleanly. So do we.
My towers hold the bridge. The road is yours.
Both camps are ash. Now the relay, before their crawler.
Wait, listen! The core reads both relays as one circuit.
When one wakes, the others dim. One machine!
Fourteen minutes. Hale will ask why the road is open.
One circuit. So every lost well went to one machine.
The battery is on the north ridge. Go west.
Captain Sol. You broke the pact. I regret this.
Scrappers on the wagon road! Riders to the circle!
The wagon from the south wells is back with Riders!
I am coming myself. Some debts are paid in person.
Captain Sol, our Commander is coming. Hold until noon.
The beacon is cracking! Without it, we cannot go home.
Enough, Captain. My machines are spent.
Go home, Director. A Sunward captain let you walk.
The shelling has stopped. The children are climbing out.
The ridge is ours. Meridian is on the south road.
The middle rig is nearest. This one counts eight guards.
Diggers are coming. Standing order two: guard the Lattice.
A Pylon. It shields the buildings around it.
Three rigs. Zero rigs. The Keystone is quiet. Thank you.
Guardian machines, out here? Foremen, fall back!
The records say they obey a key.
Twelve minutes. The drills are nine metres away. Eight.
The south mast is near your camp. Start there.
Meridian machines are coming. Copies of you. Good copies.
Warden machines! Hale must have the key already.
Understood. Stop them anyway, and save the readings.
Both masts are down. Now hold the Crown, guardians.
The Crown sleeps under you, with sixty relays.
Eight minutes. Meridian learns faster than the grey coat.
The Crown is held. So the key works.
The first column reaches the ford in thirty seconds.
Wardens on every crossing. ECHO, can you reach them?
This one is trying. The grey coat drains the garden.
Tanks on both bridges. Put Anti-tank posts at the far ends.
Juno here, south bank. Twelve crystals dark since dawn.
You held. Forty crystals went to dust meanwhile.
Two towers and a squad hold the line. Build early.
Diggers on the road to the Rise.
There, from the north! Hale taught it to walk.
An old machine, with no key either. Only orders.
The relays woke with it. Start with the south one.
That relay is failing. The last one takes the shield.
Last relay down, shield gone. Hit the knees!
Guardians, you were mine nine days ago. Stand aside.
This one counted your nine days. They are over.
It has stopped! Half its plating is gone.
Let it go. The Wardens do not chase. They guard.
Twelve minutes. The Sovereign is eleven hundred steps away.
It turns home. Tomorrow it walks on Meridian.
The west beacon is closest, with a tower. Shades first.
Teo Lind. Seven Shades, five Rangers, two Watchers, three Medics.
They have not seen us. This is the quiet hour.
One relay woke here, and a storm took our camp.
That beacon has a tower. Send the Watchers first.
Veil, on my plateau? You cost me three nights.
Director, a relay that wakes alone makes a storm.
Fourteen minutes. Dawn comes early on the plateau.
All three beacons are silent. Come home.
Take the south bridge. Its mast is nearer.
Ashfall has noticed us. Towers by the camp, please.
Our relay is up. It listens and wakes nothing.
Both masts are down. Hold the relay one minute.
Copying. The record names every relay as one.
Fourteen minutes. Meridian's crawler is on the north road.
One circuit. Every relay on Astra is one machine.
The battery is by the Crown. Towers first.
They want the dampers. Every minute walks a crew home.
Riders, to the south damper! Gently, people are inside.
Archivist, one relay waking alone made that storm.
I buried forty friends on this plateau, machine. No more.
The battery is silent. Hold until the crews leave.
Nine minutes. The crews are out. Let the dampers go.
The west mast is closest and lightly held.
Ashfall columns on the camp road. Keep a guard home.
West mast in sight. They have not seen us.
That mast is failing. Each keeps a relay asleep.
It is awake. Twelve metres of iron. Get clear!
Watch the core. It opens after every burst.
Its plating is cracking. It fires sooner now.
Veil? That machine cost me a month, Archivist.
Tonight I am only keeping the sky quiet, Director.
The second Vanguard is down. Four more are still hidden.
Twelve minutes. Meridian cuts the draw in two days.
Both masts are silent. The plateau is safe.
